meta.description: Thin wrapper, same pattern as the other 4 workflows: fires daily, calls FastAPI's /api/acquisition/outreach/process-followups, which does all the real logic (find OutreachMessage rows sent >= OUTREACH_FOLLOWUP_DAYS ago with no follow-up yet -> send exactly one follow-up each; find rows whose follow-up itself got no response after another full window -> mark them NO_RESPONSE as a terminal status). No business logic lives in this workflow. Import via the n8n REST API like the other 4 workflows (the UI's classic import path may not be visible in newer n8n versions) - see infra/n8n/README.md.
